# Keyword

Keyword.com is a digital marketing platform that provides search engine ranking tracking and SEO analytics

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/keyword/.

## Actions

- **Delete Keyword**: Delete a single keyword from a project or group.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a single project or group from Keyword.com.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Retrieve the current authenticated user's account information.
- **Get Keyword** (read-only): Retrieve all keyword settings and ranking metrics for a single keyword.
- **Get Keyword Ranking History** (read-only): Retrieve Google ranking history for specified keywords for up to 180 days.
- **Get Project Details** (read-only): Retrieve a single project's summary from Keyword.com.
- **Get Project Metrics** (read-only): Retrieve keyword movement metrics for a project, group, or tag.
- **Get Share of Voice History** (read-only): Retrieve Share of Voice data over time for a specific project.
- **Get Top Pages** (read-only): Retrieve Top Pages data for a project showing ranking URLs with keyword counts, average rank, search volume, and cost per click metrics.
- **List Active Projects** (read-only): Retrieve all active projects with their groups, tags, and keyword counts.
- **List Alerts** (read-only): Retrieve all alerts for the Keyword.com account with pagination and sorting options.
- **List Keywords** (read-only): Retrieve all keywords and their ranking data in a project or group.
- **List Project Regions** (read-only): List all Google regions being tracked in a Keyword.com project.
- **Refresh Keywords**: Trigger an on-demand update for all keywords in one or more projects or groups.
- **Update Keywords**: Update keyword settings in a project.
- **Add Keywords**: Add keywords to a Keyword.com project for search ranking tracking.
- **Archive Project**: Archive a project in Keyword.com.
- **Bulk delete keywords**: Bulk delete multiple keywords from a single project by providing keyword IDs.
- **Create Project or Group**: Create a new project or group in Keyword.com account.
- **Restore Archived Project**: Restore an archived project or group.
